title: Aventador SVJ vs Huracán STO: The Real Difference
description:
Two Lamborghinis built for the track, with a very different idea of what that means. The Aventador SVJ has a twelve-cylinder engine, all-wheel drive and a Nürburgring record. The Huracán STO has a ten-cylinder engine, rear-wheel drive and a price of about two thirds. Which one is quicker depends on what you measure. We compare them with sourced numbers and show every disagreement. Our sources are Wikipedia's Aventador and Huracán pages, Motor1's report on the STO from November twenty twenty, TechCrunch from September twenty twenty-one, IEEE Spectrum, an Autocar road test, Auto Bild, and cost pages we flag as weaker. Where they disagree, we show both figures. Our own arithmetic is labelled.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
